_comment: Template for an ElectionConfig seed. Copy this file per election, fill in `election` and all three timeline_entries_* lists, then remove this _comment key. Dates are ISO 8601 local (no timezone offset); they are made timezone-aware as Europe/Amsterdam at seed time.

election.id: string, unique election identifier, e.g. TK2025
election.label: string, human-readable election name
election.category: string, one of TK, EK, PS, WS, GR, EP
election.report_error_url: URL string, optional, defaults to empty string if omitted
election.counting_info_url: URL string, optional, defaults to empty string if omitted
election.voting_url: URL string, optional, defaults to empty string if omitted

body.nl: string, Dutch body text, markdown allowed
body.en: string, English body text, markdown allowed
